title: incident-bridge: conditional routing to PagerDuty/Slack + auto-postmortem scaffolding
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an "incident-bridge" service that centralizes alert ingestion from the observability pipeline and conditionally routes incidents to PagerDuty and Slack, attaches enriched tracing/log links, and auto-generates a postmortem skeleton in the company wiki/issue tracker. The goal is to reduce MTTR by 25% for infra/runtime incidents and standardize follow-up work so on-call rotations have immediate context and a postmortem checklist created at incident creation.
acceptance_criteria: Alerts from metrics/logs/tracing pipeline can POST to /v1/incidents with trace_id, service, severity, and runbook_hint
Routing policy: critical/sevP0 -> PagerDuty + critical Slack channel; P1/P2 -> Slack only unless escalation rules matched
Postmortem scaffold created automatically for PagerDuty-triggered incidents with pre-filled fields and links to trace/span, relevant Grafana panels, and recent related alerts
Incident events and state transitions are logged to the observability console and visible on the incident dashboard
Rate limiting, deduplication, and retry/backoff implemented to avoid alert storms and duplicate PD pages
Security review completed and service uses customer-managed KMS for any secrets in Private deployments
tasks: Design API contract and schema for /v1/incidents (include optional trace_id and context_url)
Implement webhook receiver with validation and HMAC auth
Integrate PagerDuty Events V2 with dedupe keys and custom payload mapping
Implement Slack Block Kit message templates and channel mapping rules
Auto-create postmortem draft in Confluence + link to internal issue template
Add enrichment layer to look up recent spans/traces from tracing-store and attach detail links
Add Prometheus metrics for processing latency, errors, and routing counts
Create Grafana dashboard and alert rules for Incident Bridge health
E2E tests and chaos tests (burst alert simulation)
Run security review and compliance checklist for Private deployments
comments: 2025-11-03 | Ava Chen: Initial ticket created after on-call rotation spike. Scope: centralize routing logic and generate postmortem drafts to remove manual steps. Proposed schema attached in Confluence.

2025-11-05 | Rafael Morris: Design review notes: prefer explicit dedupe key generation using trace_id + alert_fingerprint. Recommend using Events V2 for PD and include soft-ack path for non-blocking Slack notifications.
2025-11-06 | Mei Patel (SRE): We need quota controls at ingress to avoid being overwhelmed by noisy rules; suggested leaky-bucket with emergent bypass for verified P0s. Added as task.
2025-11-07 | Rafael Morris: Prototype receiver implemented (internal branch). Basic PD and Slack payloads working. Added unit tests for HMAC auth. PR opened: see links.
2025-11-09 | Design feedback from Lina Ortiz (Product): Postmortem template should include a 'customer-facing summary' field and a 'rollback timeline' section. Updated Confluence template.
2025-11-10 | Security (Ibrahim Khan): Requested KMS integration design for Private deployments and removal of plaintext tokens from logs. Marked security_review_required=true. Rafael to follow up.

2025-11-11 | QA (Priya Singh): Performed burst simulation with 500 concurrent alerts. System deduped identical fingerprints and rate-limited as expected, but we saw 2% of Slack messages delayed >30s due to backoff. Added task to profile async sender.

2025-11-12 | Rafael Morris: Implemented postmortem auto-creation using internal Confluence API and created a follow-up to wire into internal issue tracker for tracking action items. Ready for in-review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incident-bridge/pull/124
implementation_notes: Service will be deployed as a k8s deployment behind the observability ingress. Use internal service account with short-lived tokens for GitHub/Confluence/PagerDuty integrations.
Prefer Go for the receiver (existing infra SDKs) and run the enrichment worker as a separate horizontal pod to allow independent scaling
Use Redis stream for de-dup and burst buffering; fallback to SQS-style queue for Private deployments without Redis
Tracing links should include span links with timestamp query params to point to exact window in Jaeger/Tempo
Expose /healthz and Prometheus metrics (incident_received_total, routed_to_pd_total, postmortem_created_total, processing_errors_total)
